text:
Milwaukee County has already acquired the entire neighborhood of 125 individual parcels of land. The new air cargo areas includes all the lands west of the airport between Howell Avenue and 6th Street, and south of the existing airport lands (adjacent to Runway 7R) to a line that extends from the intersection of 6th Street and Grange Avenue, to a point in Howell Avenue approximately 600 feet north of Grange Avenue. The relocation of buildings and site clearance has been completed. In addition the abandoned school building at the intersection of Grange and Howell Avenue's has been acquired by Milwaukee County for the Air Cargo Area.
In order to be compatible with the General Mitchell Field's new Air Cargo Area, Grange Avenue would have to be relocated north of these facilities.
An upgraded Grange Avenue route would not result in a significant decrease in travel time because signalized traffic control for the at-grade intersections will be necessary since access will not be controlled.
The proposal of a four lane divided highway, for improved access to the airport, had the support of local governmental units provided the right of access to the interstate system and ramp facilities to Grange Avenue would be approved by the Federal Highway Administration.
